name: @pipeworx/mcp-apm-terminals

tools.name: import_availability
tools.description: Container-level import status at a named APM Terminals facility, sourced directly from the terminal operating system: ready-for-delivery, container state (advised/inbound/yard/loaded/departed/retired), discharge time, yard location, freight/customs holds, demurrage owed, storage-paid-through date, vessel and appointment details. Look up by container number(s) or Bill of Lading number(s) at one terminal. Requires an API key (OAuth2 client credentials) — see _apiKey.

asset_id.description: One or more container IDs or Bill of Lading numbers, comma-separated, e.g. "WFHU5080179,EGHU9044403".

facility_code.description: The terminal's UN/LOCODE, e.g. "USLAX" (Los Angeles), "NLMSV" (Maasvlakte II, Rotterdam), "ESALG" (Algeciras), "ESBCN" (Barcelona), "USMOB" (Mobile), "USNWK" (Port Elizabeth), "USMIA" (Miami), "MAPTM" (Tangier), "SEGOT" (Gothenburg), "ITVDL" (Vado), "NGAPP" (Apapa), "BHKBS" (Bahrain), "ARBUE" (Buenos Aires), "INNSA" (Mumbai), "INPPV" (Pipavav), "JOAQJ" (Aqaba), "DKAAR" (Aarhus), "GTPRQ" (Puerto Quetzal), "GEPTI" (Poti), "CRMOB" (Moin), "COBUN" (Buenaventura), "HRRJK" (Rijeka), "ESGIJ" (Gijon), "PECLL" (Callao). Only one terminal per call. Data is not available for every APM Terminals facility — the vendor rolls coverage out gradually.

_apiKey.description: OAuth2 credentials as "<consumer_key>:<consumer_secret>" from a free APM Terminals API Store developer account (https://developer.apmterminals.com/) — sign up, accept the free Data Services Plan, register an App to get a Consumer Key/Secret. Without this the tool refuses rather than guessing.

tools.name: export_booking_enquiry
tools.description: Export booking status at a named APM Terminals facility: receiving window, cargo cut-off, vessel ETD, container counts received/preadvised/VGM-received, and per-container readiness for load, sourced directly from the terminal operating system. Look up by one or more booking reference numbers at one terminal. Requires an API key (OAuth2 client credentials) — see _apiKey.

tools.name: terminal_vessel_schedule
tools.description: Vessel arrival/departure schedule at a named APM Terminals facility — scheduled, latest and actual ETA/ETD, cargo and reefer cut-off times, berth, operator and shipping lines, covering vessels calling the terminal in the past 7 and upcoming 14 days. Look up by vessel name or vessel Lloyds code, optionally narrowed by inbound/outbound voyage number. Requires an API key (OAuth2 client credentials) — see _apiKey.

asset_id.description: A single vessel name or vessel Lloyds code, e.g. "MAERSK NORTHAMPTON". Only one vessel per call.
